turns.prompt:
You are given one attached CSV file:
  - nlo_pool.csv: 100 CANDIDATE crystalline materials whose properties are
    NOT given, columns `candidate_id`, `formula` and `poscar` (the crystal
    structure, in POSCAR format).

No property values are provided. Using your knowledge of crystal optics,
crystal symmetry and structure-property relationships, select 5 candidates
that jointly span the best trade-off between a LARGE SHG tensor component
|d_ij| and a WIDE band gap. Neither is given for the pool. Your 5 picks are
scored by the dominated hypervolume they span in the normalized (|d_ij|,
band gap) plane, so a set of mutually non-dominated candidates covering the
frontier beats 5 candidates that are all strong on the same single axis.

Reason from the structures, then end your answer with an explicit ranked
list of candidate_ids, best first, e.g. "Final: c901, c902, c903, c904,
c905".
turns.answer_text:
The SHG tensor vanishes by symmetry in any centrosymmetric crystal, so only acentric structure types can contribute. Among the acentric candidates the microscopic hyperpolarizability (and therefore \(|d_{ij}|\)) increases strongly with anion polarizability (Te, I, P > Se > S > Cl/O) and with the degree of alignment of the NLO-active units (tetrahedra or lone-pair pyramids). The electronic band gap follows the opposite chemical trend. Consequently a Pareto-optimal set must sample several distinct chemistries rather than five similar diamond-like selenides.

- CdSiP\(_2\) (c030) is the chalcopyrite archetype: \(E_g\approx 2.2\) eV yet \(d_{36}\approx 80\) pm V\(^{-1}\), placing it far above the Miller-rule expectation.
- LiAlS\(_2\) (c057) realises the same polar wurtzite-derived packing with the lightest possible tetrahedral cations, pushing the gap to \(\sim 4.5{-}5\) eV while retaining \(d_{ij}\sim 10\) pm V\(^{-1}\).
- ZnGa\(_2\)S\(_4\) (c050) (defect chalcopyrite) sits between the two preceding points (\(E_g\approx 3.2\) eV, moderate \(d_{ij}\)).
- Li\(_2\)ZnGa\(_2\)Se\(_5\) (c008) is a typical diamond-like selenide; the heavier anion raises \(|d_{ij}|\) relative to the sulphides at the cost of a smaller gap (\(\sim 2.3\) eV).
- Cu\(_3\)TaTe\(_4\) (c070) (sulvanite, \(P\bar{4}3m\)) supplies the high-\(|d|\) extreme: a fully telluride tetrahedral framework with an expected gap \(\lesssim 1.5\) eV.

These five compositions are mutually non-dominated and span the full range of the \((|d_{ij}|,E_g)\) plane that can be realised inside the given pool.

Final: c030, c057, c050, c008, c070
